cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
Do you identify as a gamer? As a Video Game Test Associate you will work with like-minded, innovative, and fun teams. You'll use your critical-thinking gamer-brain to identify issues within game titles at appropriate times, and then properly communicate them to the development team to steward quality.
Experience with Video Game Consoles is a huge plus for this position.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Of the role include but are not limited to the following:
Ownership of one or more game areas and features
Applies appropriate testing methodologies for areas of ownership
Create test cases, plan test coverage and identify risks
Create and perform manual and automated test scripts
Communicate with developer or production regarding areas of ownership, bugs or build deliveries
Use data to analyze and drive test coverage
Train and mentor Test Associates
Review work done by Test Associates to ensure accuracy and consistency
Solve problems independently and shares solutions with across teams
Proactively escalates risks, concerns, or larger problems appropriately to Test Lead
May present training, process improvements or postmortems.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Strong knowledge of personal computers, applications software, and operating systems
3+ Years of experience in software test in the gaming industry
Experience leading, coaching and mentoring junior STE's and Test Associates
Ownership of features or areas of a product
Familiarity with software development product lifecycle
Demonstrated investigative and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn new information quickly
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment
Technical training certification, Associate degree, or equivalent work experience/training
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the gaming industry or a video game enthusiast
Proficient with word processing and spreadsheet applications
Data analysis software
Microsoft Office Suite
Bachelor's degree

Of the role include but are not limited to the following:
Own one or more game areas and features
Apply appropriate testing methodologies for areas of ownership
Create test cases, plan test coverage, and identify risks
Create and perform manual and automated test scripts
Coordinate with developers or production on areas of ownership, bugs, or build deliveries
Use data to analyze and guide test coverage
Train and mentor Test Associates
Review work done by Test Associates to ensure accuracy and consistency
Solve problems independently and document solutions for relevant teams
Escalate risks, concerns, or larger problems to the Test Lead as warranted
Prepare and deliver training materials, process improvements, or postmortems as needed
cond_0151.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of experience in software testing in the gaming industry
Strong knowledge of personal computers, applications software, and operating systems
Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring junior STEs and Test Associates
Familiarity with software development product lifecycle
Demonstrated investigative and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn new information quickly
Proficient with word processing and spreadsheet applications
Technical training certification, associate degree, or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the gaming industry or background as a video game enthusiast
Ownership of features or areas of a product
Data analysis software experience
Microsoft Office Suite proficiency
Bachelor's degree

You'll work closely with like-minded teams in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where staying in regular contact with developers and fellow testers is a core part of the job.
cond_0348.responsibilities:
Ownership of one or more game areas and features
Apply appropriate testing methodologies for areas of ownership
Create test cases, plan test coverage, and identify risks
Create and perform manual and automated test scripts
Communicate daily with developers or production regarding areas of ownership, bugs, or build deliveries
Use data to analyze and drive test coverage
Train and mentor Test Associates
Review work done by Test Associates to ensure accuracy and consistency
Solve problems independently and share solutions across teams
Proactively raise risks, concerns, or larger problems to the Test Lead
May present training, process improvements, or postmortems
cond_0348.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of experience in software testing in the gaming industry
Strong knowledge of personal computers, applications software, and operating systems
Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring junior STEs and Test Associates
Ownership of features or areas of a product
Familiarity with software development product lifecycle
Demonstrated investigative and problem-solving skills
Ability to learn new information quickly
Proficient with word processing and spreadsheet applications
Technical training certification, associate degree, or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Experience in the gaming industry or background as a video game enthusiast
Experience with video game consoles
Data analysis software
Microsoft Office Suite
Bachelor's degree
